title: TRAIL-CC: Trachelectomy, Radical Hysterectomy, and Intimate Life After Cervical Cancer Study
brief_summary: The objective of this study is to compare radical hysterectomy with trachelectomy on outcomes related to intimacy, sexual health, and mood immediately before, 1 month after, and 6 months after surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Women who have a diagnosis of cervical cancer
2. Women who are scheduled for either a radical hysterectomy or radical trachelectomy at the British Columbia Cancer Agency - Vancouver Cancer Centre
3. Proficient in English

Exclusion Criteria:

No woman who meets the inclusion criteria will be excluded from participating.
study_population: Women diagnosed with cervical or endometrial cancer
